jobs.title: Entry-Level Security Officer – Training Provided
jobs.description:
Entry-Level Security Officer – Training ProvidedJob Description

ORN Security Solutions is looking for dependable people who are interested in starting a career in the private security industry.

No previous security experience is required.

In fact, we're specifically interested in people who are willing to learn. If you've thought about working in security but didn't know how to get started, this may be a good opportunity to get your foot in the door.

This is an entry-level position starting at $14.00 per hour. Both full-time and part-time schedules are available.

We want to be upfront about the starting wage. We're looking for people who want an opportunity to learn the profession, gain real-world experience, and potentially advance into positions with greater responsibility as they gain experience and additional licensing.

What You'll Do

This is a professional security position. Depending on your assigned shift, responsibilities may include:

  • Monitoring entrances and access points
  • Observing activity on the property
  • Conducting routine foot or property patrols as assigned
  • Helping maintain a safe and orderly environment
  • Professionally interacting with employees, visitors and members of the public
  • Identifying and reporting unusual or suspicious activity
  • Completing basic written activity and incident reports when necessary
  • Following site procedures and instructions
  • Contacting supervisors or emergency services when appropriate

This is not a law-enforcement position. We emphasize observation, professionalism, communication, documentation and good judgment.

What We're Looking For

Experience isn't our biggest concern. Reliability is.

We're looking for people who:

  • Show up when they're scheduled
  • Arrive on time
  • Have reliable transportation
  • Can communicate professionally
  • Can remain alert and attentive during a shift
  • Are comfortable working independently
  • Can follow instructions and established procedures
  • Are willing to learn
  • Take pride in their appearance and professionalism
  • Can meet the requirements to work legally in the Texas private security industry

New to Security? That's Okay.

Everybody in this industry started somewhere.

We're a locally owned DFW security company, and we're willing to work with the right people who have the attitude and reliability we're looking for.

We'll help you understand the job, learn professional security practices, and gain actual experience in the field. For employees interested in making security a career, there may also be opportunities to pursue additional training, licensing and greater responsibility as our company grows.

We would rather find a dependable person with the right attitude and teach them than hire someone with years of experience who doesn't take the job seriously.

Position Details

Pay: $14.00 per hour
Job Types: Full-time and Part-time
Location: Dallas, Texas
Experience: No previous security experience required

About ORN Security Solutions

ORN Security Solutions is a locally owned Dallas-Fort Worth security company providing professional security and patrol services throughout the area.

We believe good security starts with dependable people, professional conduct and doing the job the right way.

If you're looking for an opportunity to enter the security profession and you're willing to show up, learn and work, we'd like to hear from you.

ORN Security Solutions
Defend. Deter. Deliver.

Pay: From $14.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

  • Are you willing to complete the training and licensing requirements necessary to work as a security officer in Texas?
  • What interests you about starting a career in the security industry?

Shift availability:

  • Day Shift (Preferred)
  • Night Shift (Preferred)
  • Overnight Shift (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

  • Dallas, TX 75237 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Underground Utility CCTV Operator- (Open to Entry Level)
jobs.description:
Underground Utility CCTV Operator- (Open to Entry Level) – Launch Your Underground Utility Career with Paid Training

Job Overview

  • Company: BCAC Underground, LLC
  • Salary/Pay Rate: 17.00–26.00 / hour
  • Location: Haltom City, TX
  • Job/Employment Type: Full Time
  • Schedule: Full Time
  • Mandatory Licences & Certifications: Valid Driver's License
  • Department: Field Operations
  • Reports To: Field Supervisor / Project Manager
  • FLSA Status: Non-Exempt (Hourly)

Job Overview

The Underground Utility CCTV Operator is responsible for the setup, operation, and post-processing of closed-circuit television (CCTV) inspection equipment used to assess the condition of underground infrastructure, including sanitary sewer mains, storm drains,

force mains, and related utility systems. The operator produces accurate inspection reports used by engineers, municipalities, and project managers to evaluate pipe conditions and prioritize rehabilitation or replacement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set up and operate mainline and lateral CCTV inspection equipment (crawler systems, push cameras, etc.) in accordance with project specifications and safety protocols
  • Perform pipeline inspections per NASSCO PACP, LACP, and MACP coding standards
  • Accurately code and document pipe defects, structural anomalies, and service connections in real time using industry-standard software (WinCan, ICOM, or equivalent)
  • Prepare and submit complete, accurate inspection reports including video, photos, and defect logs
  • Operate and maintain jetting/vacuum equipment when required for pre-cleaning pipes prior to inspection
  • Perform traffic control setup in accordance with MUTCD standards and applicable local requirements
  • Conduct confined space entry procedures and atmospheric testing in compliance with OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146
  • Maintain, clean, and perform basic field repairs on all CCTV and associated equipment
  • Communicate daily with supervisors regarding inspection progress, site conditions, and any issues encountered
  • Ensure all work is performed in compliance with OSHA, DOT, and company safety standards
  • Complete daily field logs, equipment checklists, and timesheets accurately

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • High school diploma or GED equivalent.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.
  • Ability to pass background check, drug screening, and MVR check
  • Physical ability to work in outdoor environments and confined spaces

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

  • NASSCO PACP/LACP/MACP Certification-Will provide training
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 (Construction) certification-Will provide training
  • Confined Space Entry Certification-Will provide training
  • Experience with WinCan, ICOM, Granite XP, or similar pipeline inspection software
  • First Aid / CPR certification-Will provide training

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. regularly
  • Ability to work in confined spaces, manholes, and underground environments
  • Ability to stand, kneel, bend, and work in physically demanding field conditions
  • Comfortable working in all weather conditions including extreme heat and cold
  • Ability to work at or near active traffic lanes

Working Conditions

  • Outdoor field environment — municipal streets, easements, job sites
  • General Construction Conditions
  • Strong communication skills and a team-oriented mindset.
  • Enthusiasm for learning software applications and robotic camera operations.

Compensation

  • 0 – 3 years experience $17-$20 / hr plus performance bonus
  • 4 – 6 years experience $21-$25 / hr plus performance bonus
  • 7+ years experience $26+ / hr plus performance bonus
  • Benefits may include health insurance, paid time off,

About Us

BCAC Underground, LLC is the industry standard for underground pipe and inspection services. We deliver top-of-the-line, safe, cost-effective, and environmentally responsible solutions to meet complex utility needs. We empower our workforce through competitive pay, robust benefit options, and continuous technical training.

Learn more at https://bcacunderground.com/.

BCAC Underground, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender expression, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation, military service, or any other status protected by law or regulations. It is our intention that all qualified applicants be given equal opportunity and that selection decisions be based on job-related factors.

jobs.title: Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Entry Processing
jobs.description:
Overview


Allied Universal®, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.


Job Description


Life doesn't always follow a fixed schedule. That's why we created the Security Officer – Part Time Enhanced position: a flexible, dependable option for individuals looking to supplement their income, gain hands-on experience, or work toward a full-time career with the industry leader.


As a Security Officer Enhanced Part Time Entry Processing in Dallas, TX, this role is designed to provide reliable, consistent hours at an assigned site with the flexibility for you to earn more by picking-up additional shifts when it works for you.


Pay Rate: $16.50 / Hour


Job Schedule:

DayTimeSat06:00 AM - 06:00 PM

How This Role Works:



  • Fixed-Shift Commitment ("Anchor Shifts"): You will be hired for a designated site and weekly shift that serves as your reliable base schedule. This assignment requires a six (6) month commitment.

  • Earn More, Claim-A-Shift Program: In addition to your fixed shift, you may pick-up extra shifts through our scheduling platform, allowing you to increase earnings and gain experience across multiple sites. Work part-time hours this week and full-time the next. Its all up to you.


This role is ideal for candidates seeking part-time employment with flexibility, income stability, and opportunities to build-up to a full-time schedule of up to 40 hours per week; always with the option to scale back when needed.


Responsibilities:



  • Provide customer service to clients, drivers, employees, and visitors by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and when appropriate, emergency response activities at a logistics and distribution location.

  • Monitor access points, verify credentials and authorization, maintain visitor and driver entry records, and help control access to restricted areas.

  • Observe inbound and outbound vehicle traffic, communicate access instructions, and report unusual activity, policy violations, or access concerns to appropriate personnel.

  • Respond to incidents and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, following site-specific reporting and escalation procedures.

  • Conduct regular and random patrols around the facility, shipping and receiving areas, parking areas, and perimeter to help identify unauthorized access or other security-related concerns.


Minimum Requirements:



  • Be at least 21 years of age.

  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.

  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.

  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.

  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.

  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.

  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.

  • A valid driver's license will be required for driving positions only.


Why Join Us:



  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.

  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.

  • Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.

  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.


Closing


Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.


If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.
